explication: RackPeek documents and manages homelab infrastructure through a shared domain used by its web UI and CLI. Users add, edit, inspect, connect, search, report on, graph, and export hardware, systems, and services. State is held in YAML-backed resource collections; optional Git use cases synchronize that configuration with a remote repository. The graph reflects sampled composition and registrations; several UI-to-domain calls are inferred only from named command/use-case boundaries and are therefore kept limited.
